nina: quick poll: single iterator API across py/ts/go + thin transport adapters? keeps UX consistent.
omar: yes, but adapters must clearly own transport retries & reconnects. core should orchestrate high-level retry intents only.
felix: agree. propose minimal adapter surface: fetch(window,resume,opts)->(items,resume_token,flags) ; close(); capabilities(). map transport errors to Transient/ResumeInvalid/Fatal.
nina: token versioning note: prefix tokens with version label (v1:,v2:) so adapters can be forward-compatible. servers include deprecated_until when rotating.
omar: multiplexing = optional capability after handshake. ship non-multiplex first.
felix: telemetry checklist: fetch_latency, retry_count, resume_reject_rate. ops alert if resume_reject_rate > 1% over 5m.
sre-bot: RFC stub created: https://r.rw/sdks/iter-adapter (auto)
nina: actions: nina -> python prototype, omar -> header negotiation sketch, felix -> tests for stale/malformed tokens. will draft RFC next week.
